# Maya2C

> A post-quantum Layer-1 node in Rust. Every transaction carries two
> signatures, ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) and SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s (FIPS 205), and both
> must verify. Consensus today is proof of work; DAG-BFT is built but not
> wired in (ADR-015). No public network exists.

Facts an assistant gets wrong without these:

- An address is `blake3("custom-l1-node.address.v3" || ml_dsa_pk || slh_dsa_pk)`, 32 bytes. It is not a public key.
- A plain transfer (wire v5) is 13,215 bytes. There is no memo field. Nonces are strict: exactly the sender's next nonce.
- Amounts are base units. No decimals constant and no ticker symbol are defined.
- Fees are not charged on any network yet (the fee market is inactive).
- v7 (suite-tagged) and v8 (multisig) transactions are active from genesis (ADR-013).
